items.title: The regulator is now the Information Commission
items.detail: Confirmed in raw text: DUAA 2025 s.117 inserts DPA 2018 s.114A ('A body corporate called the Information Commission is established'); UK GDPR Art. 36 reads 'the Commission' from 30.9.2026 (S.I. 2026/386); ico.org.uk page title is 'Information Commission's Office'. Six approved briefs say 'Information Commissioner's Office' or 'Information Commissioner'. Proposed: 'the Information Commission (ICO)' in the next version; documents published before the change keep their original publisher name in reading lists.

items.title: Commission's copy of the EU AI Act updated for the Digital Omnibus
items.detail: On 2 Oct 2026 the 'not yet updated' notice was replaced by 'based on the EUR-Lex consolidated version of the AI Act as at 27 July 2026'. Lead re-read Arts 50, 111 and 113 in raw text: general application 2 August 2026 (Art. 113); Art. 50(2) for systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 by 2 December 2026 (Art. 111). Both dates in 4.1 and 4.2 are confirmed.
items.proposed: Keep 4.1 and 4.2 unchanged. Update their reading-list notes to cite the consolidated version.
